name: HYDRA-UMC-PHYSICS-REPLICA
notes: Functional v0: real forward kinematics and joint-limit validation (`fk`/`validate-limits` subcommands) over a real, documented-partial URDF subset (revolute/continuous/prismatic/fixed joints). src/urdf.rs now walks each joint's real `parent`/`child` link names from the document's own real root link into a single serial chain, in genuine root-to-leaf order regardless of `<joint>` element order in the file - a real branching tree (one link with more than one child joint) is refused, not flattened. Plus a real joint-limits corpus (src/corpus.rs) and a fail-safe `fk-checked` subcommand: forward_kinematics_checked() refuses to compute a world-frame pose for a joint position outside its declared URDF limit, closing the gap where plain fk would silently compute a physically-unreachable pose. Inverse dynamics by the recursive Newton-Euler algorithm over the `<inertial>` blocks, self-collision with capsules built from `<collision>`, a trajectory check and an HTTP service with `/fk`, `/ik`, `/check-trajectory` are in. Contact simulation with MuJoCo or PhysX stays future work: MuJoCo is only an optional bridge behind a Cargo feature that is off by default. Reader hardening: only joints directly under <robot> are read (ros_control transmissions parse), a link with two parents, duplicate joint names, unknown links and a zero axis are errors, a continuous or fixed joint has no position limit, and a misspelt or missing joint in --joints is an error instead of a pass. fk --json prints the position and the rotation as a unit quaternion.
